verifications.claim: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on April 22, 1970'; R2: 'on April 22, 1970'; R3: 'observed annually on April 22'; R4: 'Celebrate Earth Day on April 22'; R5: 'Every year on April 22'; R6: 'annual event on April 22'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Earth Day is annual on April 22.

verifications.claim: Earth Day marks the anniversary of the first Earth Day in 1970.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Celebrating Earth Day’s 56th Anniversary! The first Earth Day took place on April 22, 1970'; R3: 'The First Earth Day: April 22, 1970'; R5: 'started in 1970'; R6: 'First held on April 22, 1970'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm annual event on date of first Earth Day in 1970, explicitly noting anniversary in R2.

verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: Sources directly attribute launch of modern environmental movement to first Earth Day in 1970.
